title: indigo_hexdump tool: generate embedded .dat/.data byte lists without the system hexdump, also on Windows
description:
Requested by the owner on 2026-11-20.

Today files embedded into C arrays are converted with the system hexdump (hexdump -v -e '1/1 "0x%02x, "'), which does not exist on Windows. Therefore indigo_drivers/agent_scheduler/Sequencer.js.dat and indigo_drivers/agent_scripting/boot.js.dat are checked in, and the Windows build silently uses a stale copy when a regeneration is forgotten.

Add a small portable tool indigo_tools/indigo_hexdump (C, no INDIGO library dependency, built like indigo_generator) that writes any input file in exactly this format: every byte as '0x%02x, ' on one line, no header and no trailing newline, so the output is byte-identical to the current hexdump command. Usage to be settled in implementation, e.g. indigo_hexdump INPUT OUTPUT, with stdin/stdout when an argument is omitted so that 'gzip | indigo_hexdump' keeps working.

Replace every project use of hexdump with the tool:
- indigo_drivers/agent_scheduler/Makefile.inc (Sequencer.js.dat)
- indigo_drivers/agent_scripting/Makefile.inc (boot.js.dat)
- indigo_server/Makefile (resource/*.data, two rules, gzip stays in front)
- indigo.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj, four shell script build phases; add the tool sources to the project and make the phases depend on the built tool
- indigo_test/Makefile where it depends on the .dat files
Vendored code mentioning hexdump (duktape, libgps) is not in scope.

Windows: add indigo_tools/indigo_hexdump.vcxproj to indigo_windows.sln and a pre-build step in indigo_agent_scheduler.vcxproj and indigo_agent_scripting.vcxproj that regenerates the .dat from its source, with a project dependency on the tool. Visual Studio project files are not added to the Xcode project.

Build order: the root Makefile already builds indigo_tools before the drivers and the server; make sure standalone driver builds (Makefile.drv, indigo_test) and package/cross builds find a host-runnable tool.

To decide with the owner during the ticket: whether the two .dat files stay checked in once every build can generate them (removing them from git needs a .gitignore entry and affects ticket a3b3c361 and the '*.dat -whitespace' .gitattributes exception), and whether the tool is installed with the other tools or is build-only like indigo_generator.

Verification: tool output compared byte for byte with hexdump for the current Sequencer.js, boot.js and a gzipped resource, including an empty file and bytes >= 0x80; full make build and the affected tests (agent_scripting, agent_scheduler, agent_mcp integration targets). The Windows build cannot be run on this host and must be stated as unverified. Update SCHEDULER.md where it describes the hexdump build rule.

outcome.summary: Review of 6f96ad729 (claude-opus-5-5). Required: (1) .gitattributes:2 adds '*.vcxproj whitespace=cr-at-eol', a repository-wide attribute that neither the ticket nor the owner notes approve (the ticket names .gitattributes only for the '*.dat -whitespace' exception). It exists so that the configured whitespace check (git diff --check) accepts the CRLF lines added to the CRLF agent .vcxproj files (verified: the added PreBuildEvent lines end in CR LF). Under scope-approval this needs the owner's explicit approval recorded in the ticket, or the owner's choice of another handling; it must not land silently. Owner information, not required here: (2) on Windows with Git for Windows' default core.autocrlf=true, boot.js and Sequencer.js are checked out with CRLF, so the new pre-build steps embed CR bytes and rewrite the tracked boot.js.dat with different content after every Windows build (the tool's binary I/O cannot prevent checkout translation); avoiding it needs an eol attribute for these sources, an owner decision. (3) Sequencer.js and boot.js are not items of the agent .vcxproj files, so the Visual Studio IDE fast up-to-date check may skip the agent project when only the .js changed (inference, unverified; msbuild from the command line runs the pre-build). (4) No ticket note records the verification results, the unverified Windows build, the check of indigo_windows/gcc (client library only) and make_indigo_drivers (no agent wiring), or the Windows verification steps the owner asked for. Verified OK: C tool (binary I/O, _setmode for std streams, error paths remove partial output, MSVC-compatible C); output byte-identical to hexdump for Sequencer.js, boot.js and master's Sequencer.js.dat; make -C indigo_test test-buildsystem 17 tests OK; standalone make -j8 of agent_scheduler with Sequencer.js.dat and the tool deleted rebuilt both and the archive; touching Sequencer.js regenerates the .dat and recompiles; indigo_test rule regenerates a missing .dat; server rules dry-run c

Second-round review of 13625e67a (claude-opus-5-5, anthropic, reasoning high), full diff master...HEAD. Required: (1) indigo_tools/indigo_hexdump.vcxproj sets no IntDir, so it inherits $(Configuration)\$(Platform)\ from Directory.Build.props:19 relative to indigo_tools and shares indigo_tools\<Config>\x64\ with indigo_prop_tool.vcxproj (also no IntDir). MSBuild reports MSB8028 for shared intermediate directories (incorrect clean/rebuild: cleaning one project deletes the other's intermediates, shared vc143.pdb under msbuild /m). The repository already fixes exactly this for the same neighbour in indigo_tools/indigo_solver.vcxproj:64-67 (comment: indigo_prop_tool builds in the same folder). Add the same PropertyGroup <IntDir>$(Configuration)\$(Platform)\$(ProjectName)\</IntDir> to indigo_hexdump.vcxproj. Owner information, not required (pre-existing, same rule shape on master): the make rule 'indigo_agent_scheduler.c: Sequencer.js.dat' (agent_scheduler/Makefile.inc:3, likewise agent_scripting/Makefile.inc:3) does not make the object recompile under GNU make 3.81. Reproduced in the worktree: touch Sequencer.js, make -f ../../Makefile.drv all regenerates Sequencer.js.dat (18:53:42) but indigo_agent_scheduler.o stays at 18:26:56 and make -n then reports nothing to do, so an incremental build keeps the old embedded Sequencer.js until indigo_agent_scheduler.c changes; the first round's 'touching Sequencer.js ... recompiles' could not be reproduced. A fix would be 'indigo_agent_scheduler.o: Sequencer.js.dat' (and indigo_agent_scripting.o: boot.js.dat); fresh builds are not affected. Verified OK: .gitattributes is exactly the approved content (existing '*.dat -whitespace', '*.vcxproj whitespace=cr-at-eol', eol=lf for agent_scripting/boot.js and agent_scripting/library/Sequencer.js only); both .js blobs are LF in the index (0 CR), git ls-files --eol shows i/lf w/lf attr/text eol=lf, worktree status clean, so no renormalisation. First-round required item resolved as the owner

Third-round review of 680180fff (claude-opus-5-5, anthropic, reasoning high), full diff master...HEAD against the description, owner notes and answers. Verdict pass; no required code change. Both second-round findings fixed: indigo_tools/indigo_hexdump.vcxproj:64-67 sets IntDir $(Configuration)\$(Platform)\$(ProjectName)\ exactly as indigo_solver.vcxproj:64-67 (Directory.Build.props:19 default no longer shared with indigo_prop_tool); agent_scheduler/Makefile.inc:5 and agent_scripting/Makefile.inc:5 make the object depend on the .dat. Before close, owner decisions: (1) the description reserves for the owner whether the tool is installed or build-only, and no decision is recorded; the change makes it build-only (indigo_tools/Makefile:36-39, MAKEFILES.md:36). The description's premise 'build-only like indigo_generator' is wrong: indigo_generator is in TOOL_NAMES (indigo_tools/Makefile:33) and is installed by make install. If the owner wants it installed, a one-line change is needed and this review becomes stale. (2) indigo_server/Makefile:61-70 extends the object-dependency fix to the server (lists turned into CTRLPANEL_DATA/CTRLPANEL_FILES, indigo_server.o depends on all 32 .data). Not literally in the owner's 'fix both' answer, but the same defect for the same Sequencer.js in a Makefile the ticket changes; behaviour otherwise unchanged: the lists equal the 32 #include "resource/..." lines of indigo_server.c exactly; the only targets affected are indigo_server.o itself and $(BUILD_BIN)/indigo_server, which already required ctrlpanel; install/uninstall/clean/clean-all/status do not depend on it; no other build file compiles indigo_server.c; the Windows server does not embed resources (indigo_server.c:1815). It also removes a pre-existing -j race (indigo_server.o could compile before the .data existed). Owner to confirm. history.text: Owner decision of 2026-11-20, resolving the open question about checked-in files for Sequencer.js.dat: remove indigo_drivers/agent_scheduler/Sequencer.js.dat from git (git rm, add it to .gitignore) and generate it from indigo_drivers/agent_scripting/library/Sequencer.js with indigo_hexdump whenever it is missing or older than the source, in every build that includes it: Makefile.inc of agent_scheduler, the Xcode build phases, the indigo_agent_scheduler.vcxproj pre-build step and the indigo_test targets that compile indigo_agent_scheduler.c. A clean checkout must build without the file present. Keep the Xcode file reference only if the project still needs it for the generated file. Update SCHEDULER.md, which says the generated .dat is checked in. The owner named only Sequencer.js.dat: boot.js.dat stays checked in unless the owner says otherwise. Ticket a3b3c361 is left untouched.

Owner reminder of 2026-11-20: the Windows part is mandatory, not optional. Once Sequencer.js.dat is no longer in git, the Visual Studio build of indigo_agent_scheduler fails unless it generates the file itself. Required: indigo_tools/indigo_hexdump.vcxproj (plain C, compiles with MSVC, binary-mode file I/O so that no CR/LF translation changes the bytes), added to indigo_windows.sln; a pre-build step in indigo_agent_scheduler.vcxproj that runs the built tool on ..\agent_scripting\library\Sequencer.js for every configuration and platform; a solution project dependency so the tool is built first; the same wiring checked for any other Windows build path (indigo_windows/make_indigo_drivers, indigo_windows/gcc). The ticket is not complete without these files. This host cannot run the Windows build: report it as unverified and give the owner the exact steps to verify it on Windows before closing.

Implementation record (coordinator, from the implementer's and reviewer's reports, 2026-11-20). Verified on macOS: indigo_hexdump output byte-identical to hexdump -v -e '1/1 "0x%02x, "' for Sequencer.js, boot.js, a gzipped resource, an empty file and all 256 byte values; build of agent_scheduler with Sequencer.js.dat and the tool absent regenerates both; test-agent-scheduler 134/134, test-agent-scripting 39/39, test-buildsystem 17/17; test-agent-mcp fails 1 case (test_agent_mcp.c:211 expects 0x03000003, driver is 0x03000004), reported as present on master and unrelated; Xcode target indigo_hexdump builds, full Xcode library link not proven (libgps not built in the worktree). Windows NOT built or run; project files inspected as text only. Other Windows paths checked: indigo_windows/gcc builds only the client library and make_indigo_drivers has no agent wiring, no change needed. Windows verification steps for the owner, from a fresh clone without Sequencer.js.dat: (1) msbuild indigo_windows.sln /t:Build /p:Configuration=Release /p:Platform=x64, expect build\Release\x64\indigo_hexdump.exe built before the agents and indigo_agent_scheduler.dll to link; (2) repeat with /p:Platform=ARM64 and /p:Configuration=Debug, the x64 tool must be the one used; (3) fc /b the generated Sequencer.js.dat against one generated on macOS; (4) git status shows boot.js.dat unchanged. Known open points: with core.autocrlf=true the .js sources are checked out CRLF and the generated .dat embeds CR; the VS IDE fast up-to-date check may not notice a changed .js.

Review asked for changes on one point that needs the owner: the change adds '*.vcxproj whitespace=cr-at-eol' to .gitattributes so that the whitespace check accepts the CRLF lines added to the two agent .vcxproj files. Approve this line, or choose another way (LF lines in CRLF files, or accept a failing whitespace check)? Second: add '*.js eol=lf' style attributes for boot.js and Sequencer.js so a Windows checkout with core.autocrlf=true does not embed CR bytes and rewrite boot.js.dat?

Owner, 2026-11-20: 'Schvaľujem oba' - approves both .gitattributes changes: (1) the line '*.vcxproj whitespace=cr-at-eol' stays; (2) add an eol=lf attribute for the embedded JavaScript sources (indigo_drivers/agent_scripting/boot.js and indigo_drivers/agent_scripting/library/Sequencer.js) so a Windows checkout with core.autocrlf=true generates the same .dat bytes as macOS/Linux and does not modify the tracked boot.js.dat.
